step1.title: What DiuMed does
step1.body: Your phone's camera can observe optical signals from your skin. DiuMed helps you interpret them carefully — and know when to act.
step1.note: This is not a medical device.

step2.title: What it can estimate
step2.cannot: DiuMed cannot diagnose illness, measure blood oxygen accurately, or replace clinical examination.
step2.body: Camera-based measurements are optical estimates. Accuracy depends on lighting, stillness, and skin tone. Results may not reflect true physiological values.
step2.warning: If you have urgent symptoms, call emergency services.

step3.title: Privacy & Consent
step3.body: Your health data is stored in your account only. It is never sold, never shared without your consent. Camera processing happens entirely on your device.
step3.consent: I understand that DiuMed provides optical estimates, not medical diagnoses, and that I should seek emergency care for serious symptoms.
